title: E4 — HTTP overlay vs native NDN (NFD) under loss (emulation)
description: Docker topology of experiments/ndn/bench: NFD 24.07 forwarders and the @idem/gateway HTTP forwarders share each node's network namespace, so both bindings cross the same tc netem links. B0/B2/B3 run over the overlay (B0 relays plain calls), N2/N3 are B2/B3's star and tree on native NDN over UDP faces. W-syn at the E2 base point (pages capped to fit one NDN packet); every link gets the same loss in each direction. Same seeds in every mode; reductions are paired by (seed, loss) against B0.
